header: THE CONSUMER PRICE INDEX ANSWER: I build it from the saved rows (src/lib/live/cpiStore.ts) and ask MoSPI only
* when nothing is saved (everything is loaded: the new series from January 2026 and the old from 2016), or
* when a month that should be out by now is not saved (the index of a month is due on the 12th of the next, at 4 pm): then only the missing months are asked, a request or two.
When MoSPI cannot be asked or has not published, I show what is saved (the card says which month is the latest and when the next is due). I estimate nothing.

symbols.name: cpiAnswer
symbols.sig: export async function cpiAnswer({ store, now = DateTime.now(), get }: CpiDeps): Promise<Cpi>
doc: Gives the answer, loading or topping up the store first when that is due.

behaviours: nothing saved: everything is asked and saved, and the answer is built
all that is due is saved: MoSPI is not asked at all
the 12th before 4 pm: October is not out yet, so nothing is asked
October is due and not saved: only October is asked (one request), saved and shown
two months behind: both are asked together
MoSPI not answering: what is saved is shown (September is the latest), nothing thrown, nothing saved
MoSPI not answering and nothing saved: an error, not an empty chart
two people opening the card at once cost MoSPI one load
